source.author: stat
source.text: arcanae moderatrix Cynthia noctis, si te tergeminis perhibent variare figuris numen et in silvas alio descendere voltu, ille comes nuper nemorumque insignis alumnus, ille tuus, Diana, puer nunc respice saltem quaeritur, incendit pronis dea cornibus almum sidus et admoto monstravit funera curru.
source.text_original: 'arcanae moderatrix Cynthia noctis, / si te tergeminis perhibent variare figuris / numen et in silvas alio descendere voltu, / ille comes nuper nemorumque insignis alumnus, / ille tuus, Diana, puer — nunc respice saltem / — quaeritur,' incendit pronis dea cornibus almum / sidus et admoto monstravit funera curru.
source.text_english: Cynthia, ruler of the hidden night, if they say that your divinity alters in triple forms and comes down into the woods with another countenance, then at least now look upon that boy who was lately your companion and the famous nursling of the groves, that boy of yours, Diana: he is sought. The goddess kindled the kindly star with her sloping horns and, as her chariot drew near, showed the dead.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tergeminam cum placat eram Stygiasque supremo obsecrat igne domos, iam iam exorabile retro carmen agens; neque enim ante leves niger avehit umbras portitor, et vinctae primis stant faucibus Orci.
reuse.text_original: tergeminam cum placat eram Stygiasque supremo / obsecrat igne domos, iam iam exorabile retro / carmen agens; neque enim ante leves niger avehit umbras / portitor, et vinctae primis stant faucibus Orci.
reuse.text_english: When he soothes the triple goddess and, with his final fire, implores the Stygian dwellings, now at last uttering a spell that can move to pity and lead back what was gone; for the dark ferryman does not yet carry off the light shades, and the chained ones stand fast at the first jaws of Orco.
